caption:
November might be my favourite month in Amsterdam. Fewer crowds, softer light, more cafés.

If you're visiting this time of year, slow down. Here's how I'd spend a grey weekend in the city.

slides.title: A slow November weekend in Amsterdam

slides.heading: Walk the canals early
slides.body: Before ten the city is quiet. Bring a warm coat and a takeaway coffee, and just wander.

slides.heading: Save museums for the rain
slides.body: Book a time slot online and keep it for the greyest afternoon. Rain becomes part of the plan.

slides.heading: Find a brown café
slides.body: Small, wooden, candlelit. Order something warm, open a book and stay longer than you planned.

slides.heading: Buy flowers for your room
slides.body: Even in November the flower stalls are full. A few stems make any hotel room feel like home.

slides.title: Save for your next city break
